_comment: THE ONE PLACE THE CELL GEOMETRY IS WRITTEN DOWN (README §3.6 R3).
Everything that needs to know where arm 2 stands reads this file: the static transform
the two-arm MuJoCo scene (tools/make_two_arm_scene.py) and the twin's own check
(windows/mujoco_twin.py). Do not copy the number into any of them.
Units: metres, in arm 1's base frame.

measured.how: tf2_echo base arm2_base -> [0.000, 0.300, 0.000]; MuJoCo scene: gripper bodies 0.3000 m apart
measured.note: y is the only non-zero component on this bench: arm 2 sits 30 cm to arm 1's left
